sample_unit: cases/encounters (87 CPC cases, 406 MedCaseReasoning cases, 364 emergency department encounters)
models_evaluated: multi-agent five-role isolated agents with moderator

links.outcome: Standalone LLM team versus single call diagnostic recall, no human-AI team assessment
links.effect: Benchmark team gain top-3 +3.0 points, top-5 +3.9; on real ED presentations the benefit reversed (top-1 40.1% vs 34.3%, p<0.0001).
links.quote: On real emergency presentations the benefit reversed (top-1 40.1% versus 34.3%, p < 0.0001), carried by the specialist role lists and surviving added objective results.

unlisted_practices: Multi-agent prompting with independent generation and moderated synthesis versus single-call LLM for diagnosis
Specialist persona role prompts versus perspective independence in LLM diagnostic teams

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of deployment-level prompting/orchestration strategies (single call vs. persona vs. independent multi-agent moderated synthesis) on clinical diagnostic reasoning benchmarks and retrospective emergency department encounters.
